items.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued October 7 at 8:26AM EDT until October 8 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description: * WHAT...Isolated minor coastal flooding expected.  * WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County, Coastal Miami Dade County and Far South Miami-Dade County.  * WHEN...From 4 PM EDT this afternoon through Thursday morning.  * IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.  * ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor coastal flooding is expected during the high tide cycle early this evening and again during the high tide cycle early Thursday morning.
items.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.
